g.text: Resource savings versus routed period · every matched seed
Lower values favor CSD on both axes; LUT4/carry remain separate resources. No combined cost weight is assumed.
96 points per panel; coincident points may overlap. Each mapped arm retains 132 FFs. All results, including wrapper-limited paths, remain visible.
Wrapped mapped counts differ from bare candidate counts and packed place-and-route utilization; all three inventories are retained in figure-data.json.
